### Pembelajaran dan Perubahan Tingkah Laku

[positiveReinforcement.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/operantLearning/skills/positiveReinforcement.data.ts)

[respondentConditioning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/learningAndBehaviorChange/respondentConditioning/respondentConditioning.data.ts)

### Sains Psikologi dan Penyelidikan

Groups: 5 · Skills: 31

[psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry.data.ts)

### Sensasi dan Persepsi

Groups: 5 · Skills: 23

[sensationAndPerception.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensationAndPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sensory information is detected, selected, organized, and interpreted into an experienced world. Psychological perception differs from simple measurement of physical stimuli or anatomy of sense organs.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana isyarat deria menjadi pengalaman kita tentang dunia sekeliling.

#### Deria Badan dan Kimia

Skills: 6

[bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Touch, pain, balance, body position, smell, and taste rely on partly distinct receptor and processing pathways. Their psychological importance lies in how signals become conscious experiences and guide action, not in cataloguing anatomy alone.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana sentuhan, sakit, bau, rasa dan deria badan membimbing pengalaman kita.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai mengapa pengalaman sakit bergantung pada lebih daripada satu isyarat tisu.

[proprioception.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/proprioception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how information about muscle and joint state supports awareness of limb position and movement even without vision.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Fahami bagaimana badan mengesan kedudukan anggota tanpa melihat.

##### Persepsi Bau

**User-friendly description (ms):** Kenali bagaimana pengalaman lalu dan konteks mempengaruhi pengecaman bau.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gustatory information supports basic taste qualities and interacts with smell and other sensory cues in experienced flavor.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana rasa dan bau bergabung untuk menghasilkan perisa.

##### Persepsi Sentuhan

[touchPerception.data.ts](../../../learningApps/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/skills/touchPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how contact, pressure, vibration, and texture are discriminated through somatosensory processing, and why perceived touch depends on stimulus location and context.

**User-friendly description (ms):** Terokai bagaimana corak kelekatan mempengaruhi hubungan dari masa ke masa.
